column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   base  <ref>  <sha>  <engine version there>
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
# A base of - means no red run was possible. Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
base
run
--end --all from inside a session ends every night
a clean tree does not end the night of the session standing in it
a deadline that has passed ends the night and says so
a later session ends a night whose deadline passed, and only that one
a night an older engine granted to the project is announced to no session
a night granted to no session is refused
a night that ran out of time lets the session stop
a night typed outside every session is refused, and nothing is granted
a note carrying a tab and a newline still leaves one line of six fields
a second grant cannot take a session past the day's continuations
a second session's grant is a second night, not a replacement
a session cannot grant a night to another session
a session id that cannot name a file is refused, and nothing is written where it points
a tool call after it clears the count
a transcript that cannot be read counts as a quiet continuation
an eight-hour grant runs until eight hours from now
and --end typed there ends every night, an older engine's included
and each bound is named in its own words
and ends that session's night and no other
and exactly one continuation is spent for it
and hands over the page as it goes
and holds no session at its stop
and it is counted as quiet, prose about a tool call included
and its stop costs that night nothing
and not into a session the night does not belong to
and refusing costs no continuation
and so is one whose session id would name a path, which is not written
and that continuation is spent like any other
and the hand-back names the bound that ended the night
and the hand-back says it was the idling that ended it
and the page shows every session's night, not only the reader's
and the refusal says how to type it inside the session
and there the refusal is charged to the night
another session in the same project is not held by that night
any one bound reached ends the night, whichever it is
inside the night's chain a red gate still refuses
nor past the day's hours
one continuation is spent per turn, not two
one continuation that called no tool is not yet the end of the night
spending past the last continuation stops at zero
the night's own session is held again inside the platform's chain
two hundred and one continuations is past the ceiling
